  ensures forall i in (d_start + len_)..len(result): (result[i] == dest[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len_: (result[(d_start + i)] == src[(s_start + i)])
  effects pure
  example Copy([1, 2, 3], 0, [0, 0, 0, 0], 1, 2) == [0, 1, 2, 0]
{

fn RemoveFront(a: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(a) > 0)
  ensures (len(a) > 0)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(a) - 1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == a[(i + 1)])
  effects pure

{
  match a {
    [] => []
    [_, ..t] => t
  }
